description: A symmetrical outdoor gate entrance at dusk, flanked by two substantial limestone or cut-stone pillars rising from a low perimeter wall of the same material. The gate itself is a solid panel in a dark charcoal or near-black painted wood or steel, set between the pillars, with two low stone steps leading up to it. Above the gate, a large multi-pane arched window is visible in the white stucco facade of the house beyond, its grid of dark metal muntins catching the fading light. On each stone pillar, a warm amber glow radiates outward and downward, illuminating the rough-cut limestone face and casting soft golden light onto the flanking planting arrangements. Two white classical urn planters, one at the base of each pillar step, overflow with lush mixed plantings — red and pink blooms, trailing lavender-purple flowers, and deep green foliage. The sky behind shows a soft pink and mauve dusk gradient, silhouetting the tree canopy above the roofline. The ground is a pale gravel path leading to the steps. The overall palette is warm neutral stone tones, charcoal gate, ivory stucco, with floral accents of pink, red, and purple. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered and symmetrical, shooting straight toward the gate with a normal to slightly wide focal length, capturing the full gate composition and both pillars equally. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
